messages:
Jamie: heads up, I just noticed the notify channel automation didn't generate pages for a 2xx error spike at 12:34 UTC. Manual pages sent to oncall.
DeployBot: alert delivered to #incidents but pager endpoint returned 502 on fanout attempt, retry queued (3 attempts).
Jamie: @Marta can you check notify-bridge? It looks like retries never left the queue. Customer impact: a handful of customer-facing requests timed out.
Marta (SRE): looking now. initial evidence: retry window stalled, bridge worker stuck in backoff loop. seeing a lot of identical error blobs: 
```
ERROR notify-bridge: fanout failure: upstream 502, enqueue id=abc123, state=queued, last_attempt=1759000000
```
Tom (Infra): I see rate-limit spikes at the edge and rapid conn resets from our pager proxy. Could be webhook gateway hiccup.
Marta (SRE): the retry runner isn't advancing markers. I can repro locally by hitting queue drain; appears a tombstone flag in redis prevents re-enqueue after TTL.
IncidentBot: automation: suppressed pages for rule onboarding-suppress for 68s (reason: orphaned-retry-detection).
Rachel (Prod): customers reported degraded responses ~12:30-12:36, some 502s. CS - Priya, have you gotten any inbound?
CS - Priya: got two emails and one chat. escalating to affected accounts now, pinged their CSMs.
Jamie: temporary mitigation: Marta, can you flush the retry tombstones? Tom, can you restart pager-proxy in staging then rotate to prod if good? I'll continue manual paging until automation healthy.
Marta (SRE): flushing tombstones now (running command).
Marta (SRE): ran: flush-retry-tombstones --pattern=notify-bridge:retry:* --confirm; queue length dropping.
Marta (SRE): monitoring replay; re-enqueue throughput is improving. pushing a short-lived feature flag to disable the orphaned-retry detection for now.
Tom (Infra): restarted pager-proxy on two AZs, warm traffic to one AZ, no errors in staging smoke. rolling to prod after 2m.
DeployBot: deploy 2026-03-18T12:45Z: notify-bridge hotfix (retry tombstone handling) -> canary pass.
Jamie: great. I'll keep manual monitoring for 30m. @Marta please create a follow-up issue with RCA notes and remediation steps. include a test to simulate tombstone cases.
Marta (SRE): will do. early hypothesis: tombstone TTL mismatch between enqueue and runner led to orphaned items that automation assumed suppressed -> no pages. adding unit and integration tests.
Rachel (Prod): coordinating customer comms. Priya, please consolidate impacted accounts list and send preliminary note that we're investigating.
CS - Priya: on it, will send short status and follow up once we have root cause summary.
Jamie: thanks. postmortem ping in #postmortems when we have RCA draft. :thumbsup:
